title: Step-Up Share After a Raised Convex Barrier Order (Ostomy Supply Program)
content:
**Clinical supply guideline - Ostomy Supply Program.** The step-up share multiplies the order's excess per 30 days (its quantity per 30 days less the tier's allowance, never below zero) in the extra barriers of a convex-barrier (A4407) refill after a written order raises the quantity. The extra barriers are the excess times the supply days divided by 30, rounded down to a whole barrier.

| Newest written order for the convex barrier signed | Step-up share |
|---|---|
| 60 days or fewer ago | One half (50%) |
| More than 60 and at most 120 days ago | Three quarters (75%) |
| More than 120 days ago, or no written order | The full share (100%) |

Age is counted in calendar days from the order date of the newest written order for the convex barrier to today.

**Boundaries (hypothetical, excess of 10 per 30 days, 90 supply days).**
- Order signed 60 days ago: 10 multiplied by one half, multiplied by 90, divided by 30, gives 15 extra barriers.
- Signed 61 days ago: three quarters, 22.5 rounded down to 22.
- Signed 120 days ago: still three quarters, 22.
- Signed 121 days ago: the full share, 30.
